name: Koshikibu no Naishi
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 60); Porter gives no dates for this poet.

poems.title: So long and dreary is the road
poems.author: Koshikibu no Naishi
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 60
poems.text:
So long and dreary is the road,
That I have never been
To Ama-no-Hashidate;
Pray, how could I have seen
The verses that you mean?
